title: R3 feature control pairs
status: Source-qualified feature controls for street-ground-base: 17 FIT, 7 frozen CHECK, 4 retired Galveston diagnostic correspondences; no model acceptance claim.

explicit_owner_role_changes: Centennial Wheel is FIT despite its old check-only label.
All three San Francisco Bay Area pairs are FIT, though their prior source record labels were check-only.
Space Needle and Lacey–Murrow are FIT despite prior check-only labels.
T-Mobile Park and Everett Darwing hall are FIT proposals.
José Rizal Bridge, West Seattle Bridge, Palace of Fine Arts and remaining listed checks stay checks.
role_policy.correlation_rule: Everett hall floor samples are from the same broad feature as the Boeing Everett geographic fit pair and must not count as independent geographic holdouts. SeaTac held parking checks are same-site correlated diagnostics. The four BC linked ferry activation controls are site-level terminal correspondences: Swartz Bay/Tsawwassen are a south-BC flow and Duke Point/Horseshoe Bay a north-BC flow; their source and terminal-definition provenance is shared by each terminal. San Francisco and Galveston flow targets are authored soft reconciliations within declared native-game-unit allowances, not observed native coordinates. Galveston’s four observed geographic/native correspondences and four authored soft targets remain retired diagnostics after the flow’s causal mainland-road loss; none is fitted in street-ground-base.
